title: Normalized point blowups dominate a Nagata local surface modification
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative normal Nagata local domain of dimension $2$ [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring, def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], and let $f:Y\to S=\operatorname{Spec}A$ be a proper morphism from an integral scheme inducing an isomorphism of function fields [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-integral-scheme, def-sc-function-field, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. There exist $n\geq0$, a tower $T_n\to\cdots\to T_0=S$, and an $S$-morphism $q:T_n\to Y$. Each arrow of the tower is the blowup at a reduced closed point above the closed point of $S$, followed by normalization in its function field [def-nagata-global-blowup, def-sc-normalization]. Each normalization is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Every $T_i$ is integral and normal, every affine open of $T_i$ has a Nagata coordinate ring, and $T_i$ is Noetherian (it has a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings) [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Every tower arrow and the composite $T_n\to S$ is proper and induces an isomorphism of function fields. The morphism $q$ is proper and induces an isomorphism of function fields.

source.place: Tags 0BBT (resolve-lemma-dominate-by-normalized-blowing-up) and 0BFT (resolve-lemma-Nagata-normalized-blowup); normalized blowup convention Tag 0BBS (resolve-definition-normalized-blowup). Normal base makes the initial normalization the identity; proper maps to the local base send closed centers to its closed point.
